snippet.title: Housefull 5 | Official Trailer | Sajid Nadiadwala | Tarun Mansukhani | In Cinemas on 6th June 2025
snippet.description:
Welcome aboard the most unpredictable cruise ever! 
Get ready for chaos, comedy, and a killer twist 👀🔪 

Presenting the Official Trailer of #Housefull5! 

Starring :  
Akshay Kumar, Abhishek A Bachchan, Riteish Deshmukh, Jacqueline Fernandez, Sonam Bajwa, Nargis Fakhri, Sanjay Dutt, Jackie Shroff, Nana Patekar, Chitrangada Singh, Fardeen Khan, Chunky Pandey, Johnny Lever, Shreyas Talpade, Dino Morea, Ranjeet, Soundarya Sharma, Nikitin Dheer, and Akashdeep Sabir 

Produced by Sajid Nadiadwala 

Directed by Tarun Mansukhani 

Story & Screenplay by Sajid Nadiadwala 

Music on Tseries 

Housefull 5 Releases in cinemas on 6th June 2025
